description.narrative: CISST aims to contribute is to bring the prison conditions in Türkiye closer to human rights and universal values. The prerequisites for this long-term change are that the responsible bodies, particularly the Ministry of Justice, fulfil their responsibilities stemming from international human rights standards more vigorously to make Türkiye a country where rights violations in prisons are effectively prevented and prisoners enjoy their human rights in full, and the stakeholders and advocates act more actively to protect the human rights of prisoners when the aforementioned bodies fail to fulfil their responsibilities.

CISST:s verksamhet syftar till att bidra till att föra fängelseförhållandena i Turkiet mer i linje med mänskliga rättigheter och universella värden. Förutsättningarna för denna långsiktiga förändring är att de ansvariga organen, särskilt justitieministeriet, uppfyller sina åtaganden från internationella människorättsstandarder så att Turkiet kan bli ett land där rättighetskränkningar i fängelser effektivt förhindras och fångar åtnjuter sina mänskliga rättigheter i sin helhet, samt att advokater och andra relevanta aktörer mer aktivt skyddar fångars mänskliga rättigheter om de tidigare nämnda organen inte fullgör sina skyldigheter.

The goal of the contribution is defined as:
CISST aims to contribute is to bring the prison conditions in Türkiye closer to human rights and universal values. The prerequisites for this long-term change are that the responsible bodies, particularly the Ministry of Justice, fulfil their responsibilities stemming from international human rights standards more vigorously to make Türkiye a country where rights violations in prisons are effectively prevented and prisoners enjoy their human rights in full, and the stakeholders and advocates act more actively to protect the human rights of prisoners when the aforementioned bodies fail to fulfil their responsibilities.
The interventions outcomes are:
-Owing to the increased awareness and empowerment of the community of prisoners and their families, more and more prisoners are able to make use of a wider range of their rights.
-More diverse non-governmental actors take action to defend and improve human rights in prisons.
-The attitude of the key actors to take action against violation of prisoners rights and for improving prison conditions have improved positively owing to civil monitoring, advocacy and dialogue by CISST.
-CISST has carried on its institutionalization and has become more resilient and sustainable by maintaining its impact power for improving human rights in the prison system.

A handover CoP was drafted as the PO is retiring. The contribution is new and the partner is currently working to achieve results. Significant results from the previous phase and starting into this one was that:
CISST has collaborated with Prison Insider to prepare a Country Profile on Turkeys penitentiary system. This comprehensive report covers diverse sub-fields and interconnected areas, offering insights into general conditions and specific aspects of Turkeys prisons. https://www.prison-insider.com/en/articles/turkiye-prisons-in-2024?referrer=%2Fen
Also, CPT has recognized the importance of CISSTs activities in strengthening the evidence-based advocacy of NGOs and civil actors concerning human rights in prisons. In visit consultation with CSOs, CISST has being invited for the first time along with HRFT.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
